map.→ 打开动物福利评分器工具: -> Open the Animal Welfare Scorecard tool
map.产犊间隔与繁殖效率评估器: Calving Interval and Reproductive Efficiency Assessor
map.分项短板定位与改进。: Locate and improve the weak items one by one.
map.基于五大自由原则对养殖场动物福利进行多维度评分（基于 Welfare Quali: Scores farm animal welfare across multiple dimensions based on the Five Freedoms (a simplified version of Welfare Quality)

map.按标准（如 Welfare Quality）设维度权重，可调整。: Set the dimension weights by a standard such as Welfare Quality; they are adjustable.
map.断尾去势操作日龄选择器: Tail Docking and Castration Age Selector
map.每维 0~10，综合换算 0~100 分；≥85 优秀、70~85 良好。: Each dimension is 0 to 10, converted to 0 to 100 overall; ≥85 is excellent and 70 to 85 is good.
map.：一维由 7 降到 4：综合分降至约 81 分，定位该维度为短板。: : One dimension dropping from 7 to 4 brings the overall score down to about 81, identifying that dimension as the weak point.
